variants.name: Current
variants.instructions: Which legal action gives you the best chance to reach 66 eyes before the opponent?

variants.name: Helps
variants.instructions: Which legal action best helps you reach 66 eyes before the opponent?

variants.name: Select
variants.instructions: Select the legal action that gives you the best chance to reach 66 eyes before the opponent.

variants.name: Your opponent
variants.instructions: Which legal action gives you the best chance of reaching 66 eyes before your opponent?

variants.name: Improves
variants.instructions: Which legal action most improves your chance to reach 66 eyes before the opponent?

variants.name: Get to
variants.instructions: Which legal action gives you the best chance to get to 66 eyes before the opponent?

variants.name: Counting eyes
variants.instructions: Which legal action gives you the best chance to reach 66 counting eyes before the opponent?

variants.name: This trick
variants.instructions: Choose the legal action that wins the most eyes on this trick. Prefer a trump marriage of 40 eyes over any other action.

variants.name: Save high cards
variants.instructions: Choose the legal action that keeps Asses and trumps in your hand. Give up the trick when that saves one. Do not close the talon.

variants.name: Close and marry
variants.instructions: Close the talon whenever that action is legal. Otherwise declare a marriage if one is legal. Otherwise play the highest card.
